scope: Bounded adoption of transaction typing and local/profile conservation contracts. No production instrumentation, scientific admission, tolerance promotion, central-registry mutation, or whole-model golden baseline.

sign_contract.internal_transfer: single directed edge source_owner->destination_owner; -q at source and +q at destination; cancels exactly when both owners lie inside the selected control volume
sign_contract.amount_rule: q >= 0; direction is never encoded by a negative amount
sign_contract.residual_equation: R = begin_storage + inputs - outputs + internal_net - end_storage
sign_contract.whole_profile_rule: internal layer-to-layer transfers cancel exactly and are excluded from the external boundary sum
sign_contract.tolerance_policy: No scientific tolerance is defined by this fragment. Numerical comparison tolerances, if later used, are execution-policy metadata only and cannot convert a non-zero physical residual into conservation.

entries.title: Typed transaction single-edge and boundary-XOR contract
inputs: event with external source and internal destination
outputs: event with internal source and external destination
internal_transfers: single edge q>=0 with source delta -q and destination delta +q
entries.residual_equation: For a closed two-owner internal transfer: R = (-q) + (+q) = 0 exactly. For a system-external event exactly one endpoint is internal.

entries.title: Single-layer conserved-quantity control-volume residual contract
entries.species: SPECIES_RESOLVED; NH4 and NO3 remain separate species even when both contribute to elemental N
storage: begin physical owner storage in selected layer
end physical owner storage in selected layer
internal_transfers: within-layer owner-to-owner transformations cancel only for an encompassing layer control volume
entries.residual_equation: R_layer = S_begin + I_external + I_interfaces + T_internal_net - O_external - O_interfaces - S_end

entries.title: Whole-profile conserved-quantity control-volume residual contract
entries.species: SPECIES_RESOLVED with optional explicitly declared elemental aggregation
storage: sum of begin physical owner storages inside profile
sum of end physical owner storages inside profile
inputs: declared lateral or lower inflow when present
outputs: crop uptake only when crop lies outside selected profile control volume
gas or other external export only when qualified
internal_transfers: soil-to-crop transfer only if crop is inside encompassing control volume
entries.residual_equation: R_profile = sum(S_begin) + sum(external_inputs) - sum(external_outputs) - sum(S_end); all internal edges cancel exactly once

entries.title: NH4/NO3 elemental-N aggregation without species erasure
internal_transfers: nitrification NH4-N -> NO3-N is internal for total-N control volume and must not be counted as external input/output
entries.residual_equation: R_N = R_NH4 + R_NO3 + residuals of other explicitly included N pools; aggregation is permitted only after species-resolved ledgers are formed

entries.title: Balance deviation/index audit adoption gate
entries.source_identity: TB01 adapters ATB-SPC-001 and ATB-CONS-001 plus MASSQ02 residual classification
entries.residual_equation: not_applicable; this gate checks ownership/index consistency and known balance deviations before conservation tests are interpreted
